# Disruption with some Copilot services

## What Changed

Oct 28, 15:28 UTC Resolved - On October 28, 2026, between 13:52 and 15:24 UTC, Copilot users saw errors when using several GPT-family models and the MAI Code 1.1 Flash model. Affected experiences included Copilot Chat in IDEs and on GitHub.com, the Copilot CLI, Copilot Code Review, the Copilot Coding Agent, Code Scanning Autofix, and Code Quality. About 9.73% of requests to the affected models failed, with a peak of about 36.97% at the start of the incident. The errors happened because a credential that we use to authenticate with an upstream model provider became invalid. We mitigated the incident by replacing the credential and redeploying the service. We are strengthening how we manage credentials for upstream providers to prevent this type of failure, returning retryable errors when an upstream provider rejects a request, and improving our monitoring so that we detect and mitigate this type of problem faster in the future. Oct 28, 15:26 UTC Monitoring - The degradation affecting Copilot has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability. Oct 28, 15:24 UTC Update - Copilot is experiencing degraded performance. We are continuing to investigate. Oct 28, 15:15 UTC Update...
